paragraphs.en: {Rainforests} are home to a {rich} variety of life and are some of the places with the greatest {botanical} diversity on Earth.Can you believe that a single bush in the Amazon may have more species of {ants} than the whole of Britain! Some species are also considered living descendants ( (后代) ) of ancient {dinosaurs} .About 480 species of {trees} may be found in just one {hectare} of rainforest.
paragraphs.cn: <u> 热带雨林 </u> 是 <u> 丰富 </u> 多样的生物的栖息地，也是地球上 <u> 植物 </u> 多样性最为丰富的地方之一。你能相信吗？亚马孙雨林的一丛灌木中的 <u> 蚂蚁 </u> 种类可能比整个英国的蚂蚁种类还要多！有些物种还被认为是远古 <u> 恐龙 </u> 的现存后代。在仅仅一 <u> 公顷 </u> 的雨林中，就可以发现大约480种 <u> 树木 </u> 。

paragraphs.en: Rainforests are the lungs of the planet—storing {vast} quantities of carbon dioxide and producing a significant amount of the world's oxygen.Rainforests have their own perfect system for ensuring their own {survival} .The {tall} trees can reach heights of over a hundred {meters} , creating a canopy ( (树冠层) ) that is often {enveloped} in {foggy} {mist} .The canopy of branches and leaves protects itself, smaller plants, and the {forest} animals from {heavy} {rain} , intense dry {heat} from the sun and strong {winds} .
paragraphs.cn: 热带雨林是“地球之肺”——储存着 <u> 大 </u> 量的二氧化碳，并为全球产出大量的氧气。热带雨林拥有一套完美的系统，可以保证自身的 <u> 存续 </u> 。 <u> 高大的 </u> 树木可以长到超过一百 <u> 米 </u> 的高度，形成一个常常被 <u> 雾气笼罩 </u> 的树冠层。枝叶构成的树冠层保护着树木自身、低矮的植物以及 <u> 森林 </u> 中的动物，使其免受 <u> 大雨 </u> 、烈日的酷 <u> 热 </u> 以及强 <u> 风 </u> 的侵袭。

paragraphs.en: {Amazingly} , the trees grow in such a way that their leaves and branches, although close together, never actually touch those of another tree.Scientists think this is the plants' way of {preventing} the spread of any tree diseases and making life more difficult for leaf-eating insects like {caterpillars} .To {survive} in the forest, animals must climb, jump or {fly} across the {gaps} .The ground floor of the forest is rich with {mushrooms} and other fungi ( (真菌) ). {Silent} predators like {tigers} move through this realm ( (领域) ).It is not all {tangled} leaves and bushes, like in films, but is actually fairly clear.It is where leaves turn into food for the trees and other forest life.
paragraphs.cn: <u> 令人惊奇的是 </u> ，这些树木的生长方式使得它们的叶子和枝条尽管彼此靠近，但从不真正地触碰到另一棵树的叶子和枝条。科学家们认为，这是植物 <u> 防止 </u> 树木间的疾病传播，并让 <u> 毛毛虫 </u> 等食叶昆虫更难生存的一种方式。为了在森林中 <u> 生存 </u> ，动物们必须攀爬、跳跃或 <u> 飞 </u> 越这些 <u> 间隙 </u> 。森林的地面层到处都是 <u> 蘑菇 </u> 和其他真菌。 <u> 老虎 </u> 等 <u> 安静的 </u> 掠食者在这个领域中穿行。它并不像电影中那样全是杂乱 <u> 缠绕的 </u> 树叶和灌木丛，实际上相当开阔。这里是树叶转化为树木和其他森林生物所需养料的地方。

paragraphs.en: They are not called rainforests for nothing! Rainforests can {generate} 75% of their own rain.At least 80 {inches} of rain a year is normal—and in some areas there may be as much as 430 inches of rain {annually} .This is real rain—your {umbrella} may protect you in a {shower} , but it won't keep you dry if there is a full {rainstorm} .In just two hours, streams can rise ten to {twenty} feet.The air is filled with the buzz ( (嗡嗡声) ) of insects, including {mosquitoes} , which thrive in {rainy} and {wet} conditions.The humidity ( (湿气) ) of large rainforests contributes to the formation of rainclouds that may travel to other countries in need of rain.
paragraphs.cn: 所谓“热带雨林”绝非浪得虚名！热带雨林能够自行 <u> 产生 </u> 75%的降雨量。每年的常规降雨量至少有80 <u> 英寸 </u> ——而在某些区域， <u> 年 </u> 降雨量可能多达430英寸。这是真正意义上的雨——你的 <u> 雨伞 </u> 或许能在 <u> 阵雨 </u> 中保护你，却无法在 <u> 大暴雨 </u> 中保证你不被淋湿。短短两个小时内，溪流就可能上涨十到 <u> 二十 </u> 英尺。这里的空气中充满了昆虫的嗡嗡声，其中就有在 <u> 多雨 </u> 、 <u> 湿润的 </u> 环境中茁壮生长的 <u> 蚊子 </u> 。大型雨林的湿气有助于 <u> 雨云 </u> 的形成，这些雨云可能会飘向其他需要降雨的国家。

paragraphs.en: Today, rainforests are under threat from human activities such as {illegal logging} .The {wounds} caused to these forests have widespread consequences.We must take steps to conserve these precious environments.
paragraphs.cn: 如今，热带雨林受到诸如 <u> 非法伐木 </u> 等人类活动的威胁。这对森林造成的 <u> 损害 </u> 会产生广泛的后果。我们必须采取措施来保护这些珍贵的生态环境。 5NoOncib/NjiX02BpMIzP4m+378Hw1xTRxUdPaP/PFjKUFq4K2G7tp6ZLYoCE601yW1W39VMdLmovFdSHs4nVQ==
